claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 2 show 'YAMAHA Professional' and 'YAMAHA PortaSound' text on the panel.
No photo or clip shows power-on, sound output, or key responsiveness; condition claims cannot be judged from static images.
No evidence either way; subjective suitability claim not shown in photos.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or produce sound
risks.proof: Video clip of the keyboard powering on and playing a few notes/demo song

risks.risk: Missing power adapter/cord needed to operate it
risks.proof: Photo of the actual adapter being included with the sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit-only, adapter to be sourced separately

risks.risk: Some keys or buttons may be stuck, broken, or unresponsive
risks.proof: Video sweeping across all keys and pressing each panel button/slider

risks.risk: Hidden damage on back/underside (cracks, battery leakage, broken ports)
risks.proof: Clear photos of the back panel and underside, including battery compartment if applicable
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible structural or battery damage

risks.risk: Exact model/tier unclear (PortaSound vs 'Professional' labeling affects value tier)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full model number/serial sticker, usually on the back
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end of plausible Yamaha keyboard models matching the visible features

proof_requests: Video of keyboard powering on and playing sound through its speakers
Photo of included power adapter, if any
Video or photo sweep showing all keys pressed and panel buttons/sliders tested
Clear photo of the back/underside and battery compartment
Close-up photo of the model number/serial plate
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used Yamaha electronic keyboard with no accessories and unknown functionality, so it can be priced at worst case (non-working, unit-only) pending proof to raise the price.
